sourceRefs.locator: TGN 7017400, historical name Dorestad and orientation at 51.9833° N, 5.3500° E.

The Oxford Handbook of the Merovingian World, pp. 772–774 and figs. 34.1–34.3. River settlements, two moneyers at Dorestad before its later port, Madelinus in the 630s and 640s and possible uses for gold coins.

processingNote.de: Die Schraffur bezeichnet die Gegend der auf der Münze genannten Stadt. Die Lage der Werkstatt ist unbekannt.
processingNote.en: Hatching marks the vicinity of the town named on the coin. The position of the workshop is unknown.
